summary: Two small changes so the calculator suits a keyboard-first workflow.

changes.title: Enter repeats the last operation
changes.what: Pressing Enter again after a result applies the same operation and operand once more, like a desk calculator (2 + 3 = = gives 8).
changes.why: Adding the same amount several times took retyping the operand each time.

changes.title: Larger result text
changes.what: The result line uses a larger font and stays right-aligned when the window is narrow.
changes.why: The result was hard to read from a distance on a laptop screen.
